decision_rule: Use target mode only: both 4-wave np8 L64k arms must have 8 successful streams, matched corpus, binary, model, args, quarter placement and GPU-idle observations. Compute each decode metric wave-range = 100*(max-min)/median across waves 1-3, stream rate = wave median of 8 streams; threshold = max(2*max(np4 anchor floor, unified range, split range),3%). Apply predeclared PLAN s10 better/no-difference/mixed rule; incomplete or invalid is UNKNOWN/INVALID. Qualification control is excluded. No deployment claim.
